title: Weapons Galore!
description: A small in development mod that aims to bring a large amount of items and weapons to Minecraft.
body:
A mod currently being developed aiming to bring a good amount of items and weapons to the game.

Made in MCreator so it's prob terrible, textures too, I have little experience with art in general.

Inspired by Hypixel Skyblock, but isn't as grindy.

CURRENT FEATURES:

WEAPONS:

- Bereft Cleaver
  - A strong but slow weapon, made after netherite.
  - I would've made it behead mobs but couldn't figure it out for the life of me, sorry.
  - There's currently a bug with how the item is rendered in your hand but idfk how to fix it.
- Atom Splitting Katana
  - A faster but weaker weapon, direct upgrade to the Bereft Cleaver.
- Hyperion
  - A slower but much stronger weapon than the ASK, direct upgrade to it.
  
CRAFTING INGREDIENTS:
  
- Catalyst
  - An item required to make (most of) everything else in this mod
- Null Sphere
  - Two ender pearls pressed into one sphere with the help of the Catalyst
- Compressed Nothingness
  - 8 Null Spheres around an eye of ender
- More, I can't be bothered to write all of ts down.
